method: Editorial screening backed by the per-record source verification and candidate screening registries; quality thresholds take precedence over country targets.
rejection_policy: duplicate semantic event, duplicate individual-article URL, or duplicate source URL plus normalized bulletin-item title
no stable direct article or dated official bulletin item with exact item-level trace
sports, entertainment, lifestyle, local incident, or insufficient national policy relevance
core fact could not be corroborated to publication standard

actor_field_audit.finding: toEventRecord currently falls back to sourceLabel when an explicit event actor is absent, so actor may contain a publisher name.
actor_field_audit.decision: Do not change only this refresh and create mixed semantics across the event library; source_name remains the authoritative publisher field and a future schema migration must address actor consistently.

notes: Reuters URLs may return an automated-access response while remaining canonical direct article URLs.

Dated official bulletin, agency-roundup, and government-briefing pages may support multiple records only when each record has a distinct source_item_title and position or anchor; individual-article URLs remain unique.
No item enters a causal model; news records remain descriptive event-library entries.
The existing event schema has no separate original-title, updated-at, or related-country field, so the update does not invent parallel fields.
